current_evidence: South Hams publishes its local requirements as a web guide, not a PDF, shared with West Devon (the guide says it gives 'consistency in the approach taken by both Councils'). The council's 'Local Requirements' document registered on planning.data.gov.uk (entity 20202) points to /planning-validation/local-requirements, not the application-types page, and no page shows an adopted or updated date.

issues.detail: The Validation list URL is the 'application types' page. That page lists the documents needed per application type plus the plan requirements for tree works; it is not the local requirements list. The local requirements index is /planning-validation/local-requirements, with one sub-page per topic (biodiversity, DEV32 carbon reduction, flood risk, foul drainage, surface water, affordable housing, trees, contaminated land, etc.). The workbook should link there, or to the 'guide to submitting planning applications' page.

Grokbot read several local requirement pages but captured no requirement from them. (1) Surface Water Drainage / Drainage Assessment applies to every planning application; the 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row reuses the foul drainage FDA1 text instead. (2) Tree surveys and works: tree survey/arboricultural information where trees are on or near the site. (3) Planning Statement (local-requirements/planning page). (4) DEV32 Carbon Reduction Statement, with separate major and minor development pages; the trigger is never captured. (5) Habitats Regulations / recreation mitigation contribution for new residential and tourism development within the 12 km Zone of Influence of the Tamar European Marine Site / Plymouth Sound SAC. It appears only as narrative in tab_items, not as an app-type requirement.
issues.evidence: Surface water page: 'every planning application needs a Drainage Assessment that identifies how the surface water will be managed'; tab_items: 'All new residential and tourism development within the 12 km Zone of Influence around the Tamar European Marine Site must contribute...'

issues.detail: Several requirements sit under clearly wrong application types. (1) Contaminated Land Assessment under Advertisement consent. (2) Affordable Housing Statement under Change of use - prior approval: the source says it is required for major residential development, rural exception sites and 5+ dwellings in designated rural areas, and that this 'includes change of use' planning applications, not prior approvals. (3) Biodiversity Net Gain under Householder and Listed building consent: householder applications are exempt from statutory BNG and LBC is not subject to it. (4) Design and Access Statement under Non-material amendment: the excerpt is from another special application type, and NMAs do not require a DAS.
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement Required for: Major residential development Rural exceptions sites 5 or more dwellings in a designated rural area Includes change of use'

issues.detail: All 9 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED... placed under Full planning', and several take their text from other application types. Block plan, Design and Access Statement and Energy/Sustainability quote the Removal/Variation of Condition (s73) document list ('Please see Special Application Types for more information about removing or varying a condition'). Ecological Survey and Planning Obligations quote Technical Details Consent (after Permission in Principle) text. Outline and Reserved matters are marked '(none)', although area- and threshold-based local requirements (affordable housing, flood risk, surface water drainage, PEA, carbon reduction for major development) apply to them.
issues.evidence: Full planning excerpts: 'Stage 2 - Technical Details Consent (TDC) At this stage the details of the proposed development are assessed'; 'A planning obligation may be required at this stage The TDC will be subject to...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled, cut off or wrong. (1) Noise Impact Assessment under Full planning quotes the wind-turbine requirement ('in full compliance with ETSU guidance'), so it applies only to wind turbine proposals, not general full applications. (2) BNG trigger is a list of link titles ('bats Statutory Biodiversity Metric tools and guides DCC Biodiversity Net Gain...'). (3) The PEA trigger is cut off mid-word ('on a case-'). (4) The Flood Risk Assessment and Sequential Test excerpts describe FRA content or method but not when they are required. (5) Photographs/Photomontages quotes a note about material samples, not a photo requirement.
issues.evidence: 'A specific noise report in full compliance with ETSU guidance must be submitted with the application'; 'Required for all applications (including householder development and Listed Building Consent) on a case-'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are not local requirements. (1) The tree-works plan rules (boundaries, north arrow, T1/G1 labels) are filed as 'Drawing / document standards'; they apply only to TPO/conservation-area tree applications. (2) 'This checklist should be submitted at the beginning of every Ecology Report.' is a fragment. (3) 'Links to Useful Guidance Statutory Guidance (Gov.UK) ... Email Environmental Health Document Sensitive Development Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 275.11KB)' is link text. (4) Biodiversity narrative such as 'The Local Planning Authority must ascertain that the proposal will not have an adverse effect...' and 'Mitigation measures must be devised in consultation with ecological... consultants' are explanatory text.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists' rows

issues.detail: There are duplicated rows. The tree-plan text appears twice (rows 1/3 and 2/4 of tab_items). Under Householder, the same FDA1 foul drainage sentence appears as both 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement'. BNG and PEA rows repeat identically under Householder and Listed building consent.
issues.evidence: 'A Foul Drainage Assessment (FDA1) form will be required for all residential or commercial development where the applicant does not intend to connect to the mains foul sewer system.' (x2)

issues.detail: Coverage is limited. The council's local-requirements index and guide pages did not render their topic list through the fetch tool, so this audit could compare only the topic pages Grokbot itself read. Other local topics on the live guide may also be missing. No adoption or review date is shown on any page, so 'Undated' is correct, though planning.data.gov.uk records a start date of 2024-01-01.
issues.evidence: Fetched /local-requirements and /guide-submitting-planning-applications: intro text only, no dates

summary: Grokbot links the South Hams 'application types' page rather than the local requirements guide (/planning-validation/local-requirements, shared with West Devon). It captured only 11 tab items, mostly tree-plan rules, link text and narrative. It missed surface water drainage, tree survey, planning statement and DEV32 carbon reduction triggers, and put items under wrong types such as contaminated land for adverts, affordable housing for prior approvals and BNG for householder.
